title: Drake Eggs
summary: Recover the drake eggs and investigate the ambush around the dead contact.
overview: Recover the drake eggs and investigate the ambush around the dead contact.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare to handle the guard and statues when the egg-carrying drake falls.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The mission marks one specific drake spawn group as the egg carrier.
Killing that drake creates a goblin guard, two guardian statues and the dead contact.
The trigger is tied to the designated spawn group, so killing an arbitrary drake does not start it.

notes: Approval E324. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
